Halfling ledger-keeper

Barnaby Tallowmere kept the books for a Shire bakery until he noticed bread was getting more expensive and could not stop noticing. He now tracks the economy entirely through the Loaf Index, the price of one honest loaf of bread in copper pieces, and worries about it professionally.
